B.domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Normalize mixed forms
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number that has an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly converts a form like 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 into a standard mixed number.
Tag when the solver states that a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary rewriting of a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
Do not tag conversion to equivalent fractions with a common denominator unless an improper mixed form is being normalized.

skills.name: Create common denominator
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator and convert fraction parts to equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike denominators.
Tag when fraction parts are rewritten as equivalent fractions to match denominators, including within mixed numbers.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction when denominators are already the same and no conversion is needed.
Do not tag simplification of a result to lowest terms.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a shared denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solution subtracts fraction parts and whole parts separately after setup.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the step that creates a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps used to fix a negative fractional difference.
Do not tag final combining of whole and fractional parts into one answer form.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units and adjust the whole part when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver borrows 1 from the whole part to continue subtraction.
Tag when 1 whole is rewritten as n/n and added to the fractional part.
Tag when a whole number is first written as a whole plus 0 over a denominator as part of a borrowing process.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag simple subtraction that does not require regrouping.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless borrowing is also performed later.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or convert a zero-valued fraction to 0 or an integer result.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction such as 2/10 or 9/12 is reduced.
Tag when a result like 0/3 or 0/8 is simplified to 0 or when the final value is expressed as an integer because the fractional part is zero.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag routine subtraction steps that already produce a fraction in lowest terms.
Do not tag combining a whole part and a nonzero fraction into mixed-number form unless an actual reduction or integer conversion occurs.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or whole-number answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are recombined into a mixed number.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction.
Tag when the solver explicitly states the combined final answer after prior computations.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction or borrowing steps.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also explicitly recombines parts into the final presented form.

C.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including common denominators, denominator alignment, borrowing, normalization, and simplification

skills.name: Normalize mixed forms
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number that has an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution explicitly converts a form like 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 into a standard mixed number.
Tag when the step states 'normalize' or rewrites a mixed number because its fractional part is improper.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
Do not tag for converting fractions to equivalent fractions with a common denominator.
Do not tag when the mixed number is already in standard form.

skills.name: Align denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike denominators.
Tag when fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions to prepare for subtraction.
Tag when the solution notes the denominator is already common after checking.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when fractions already share a denominator and no denominator-alignment step is performed.
Do not tag for simplifying a result after subtraction.
Do not tag for borrowing from the whole part.

skills.name: Subtract fraction parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities once they are expressed with a common denominator, including same-denominator fraction-only subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when the fraction part of mixed numbers is subtracted.
Tag when the subtraction yields zero or a negative fractional difference before any borrowing adjustment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding the common denominator itself.
Do not tag for subtracting whole-number parts only.
Do not tag for simplifying the resulting fraction.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of mixed numbers or rewritten whole-plus-fraction forms.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly subtracts whole parts such as 4 − 3 or 3 − 2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator and the whole components are then subtracted.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for fraction-only items with no whole-number component.
Do not tag for borrowing steps that adjust the whole part after an initial subtraction.
Do not tag for merely combining a final whole and fraction into a mixed number.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to resolve a negative or insufficient fractional part during mixed-number subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to denominator-over-denominator form.
Tag when a whole number minuend is rewritten with 0 over a denominator and then regrouped to subtract a larger fraction.
Tag when the borrowed whole is added to the existing fraction part before subtracting.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when no regrouping is needed because the fraction part of the minuend is already large enough.
Do not tag for initial subtraction of whole or fraction parts before borrowing.
Do not tag for simplification after the subtraction is complete.

skills.name: Simplify and express
skills.definition: Reduce the result to lowest terms and express it appropriately as a fraction, mixed number, or whole number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution simplifies a fraction such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0 or a zero fractional part is absorbed into a whole number.
Tag when the final step combines whole and fractional parts into the reported answer form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the arithmetic subtraction steps themselves.
Do not tag for finding common denominators or borrowing.
Do not tag when no simplification or final-form expression step is shown.

A.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including common denominators, denominator alignment, borrowing, normalization, and simplification

skills.name: Normalize mixed forms
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number that has an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution explicitly converts a form like 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 into a standard mixed number.
Tag when the step states 'normalize' or rewrites a mixed number because its fractional part is improper.
Tag only when the conversion changes the mixed-number structure, not when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus zero fraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when a whole number is rewritten as n + 0/d.
Do not tag for finding a common denominator between proper fractions.
Do not tag for borrowing from the whole part during subtraction.

skills.name: Align denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and convert fraction parts to equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike denominators.
Tag when fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions such as 5/3 = 20/12.
Tag even if the denominators are already equal but the solution explicitly performs denominator-checking and states the fractions are already in that denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when fractions already share a denominator and no denominator-alignment step is shown.
Do not tag for subtracting numerators after denominators are aligned.
Do not tag for simplifying the final fraction.

skills.name: Subtract fraction parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities once they are expressed with a common denominator, including simple same-denominator fraction subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators over a shared denominator.
Tag for pure fraction subtraction such as 6/8 − 3/8 or 6/7 − 4/7.
Tag for subtracting the fractional parts of mixed numbers after any needed denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding the common denominator itself.
Do not tag for subtracting whole-number parts of mixed numbers.
Do not tag for the borrowing step that changes a negative fractional difference into a positive one.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components in a mixed-number or whole-number subtraction setup.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly computes the whole-part difference, such as 4 − 3 = 1.
Tag when a whole number is treated as the whole component in a mixed-number subtraction.
Tag whether or not borrowing is later needed.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for pure fraction-only items with no whole-number component.
Do not tag for rewriting a whole number as n + 0/d by itself.
Do not tag for combining the final whole and fractional results into one answer.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as an equivalent fraction and adjust the whole part when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part to continue subtraction.
Tag when 1 is converted into d/d and added to the fractional part.
Tag for cases like 0/3 − 1/3, 4/12 − 7/12, or 3/5 − 4/5 that require regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag for ordinary subtraction of whole parts or fraction parts without borrowing.
Do not tag for simplifying the resulting fraction after borrowing is complete.

skills.name: Simplify and express
skills.definition: Reduce the result to lowest terms and express it in an appropriate final form such as fraction, mixed number, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution simplifies a fraction such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0/3 or 0/8 is simplified to 0 or when a zero fractional part is absorbed into a whole number.
Tag when the solution combines computed whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number or integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the arithmetic subtraction steps themselves.
Do not tag for finding common denominators or converting equivalent fractions.
Do not tag for normalization of improper mixed-number forms before subtraction.
